account: It is Day 1, just after seven in the morning. I am at town hall and have read and returned today's appointment documents. My schedule is office at eight, grain inspection at the mill at ten, lunch at home at noon, council letters at thirteen, tea with the neighbour at fifteen, and office again at sixteen thirty. The added engagement is with the innkeeper: he will meet me in my office at seventeen forty-five and escort me to the great hall for eighteen to discuss the inn's service to town. I heard him reconfirm that arrangement this morning. I do not yet know what specific proposals he intends to discuss, and have seen nothing establishing an ulterior purpose. The secretary recorded the engagement in a supplement. Yesterday the secretary reported no new correspondence or business, and the neighbour described the dockside as peaceful. This morning I have tried to ask the secretary for updates, but my question was not heard because we were too far apart. Nothing else unusual has come directly to my attention.
